answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 50 tokens for 20 epochs before selling copper tools or garden produce at the jetty market; its sponsor and referrals are published, so a sockpuppet cluster is visible. A peer dispute that succeeds slashes deposit and sponsor bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 tokens, far above flooding gains, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward.
